section: Missiles beyond IGMDP - BrahMos, Nirbhay, Astra, Pralay, hypersonic technology, Mission Shakti (ASAT)
subsections: Jointly developed and imported missiles - partner country

accepted.s: Which one of the following missiles is India's first indigenous anti-radiation missile designed to home passively on radar emissions?
accepted.x: Rudram-I is India's first indigenous anti-radiation missile. It passively homes on radar emissions to destroy enemy radars and communication sites.
accepted.tq: Identify the missile from its distinctive operational role.

accepted.s: Rudram-I is correctly described by which one of the following combinations?
o: Surface-to-air missile, launched from naval ships, 20–40 km
Air-to-surface missile, launched from Su-30MKI, 100–200 km
Air-to-air missile, launched from Tejas, more than 350 km
accepted.x: Rudram-I is an air-to-surface anti-radiation missile fired from the Su-30MKI, with a stated range of 100–200 km.
accepted.tq: Match the missile with its platform, range and trajectory.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about Pralay:
1. It is a quasi-ballistic short-range surface-to-surface missile.
2. It has a stated range of 150–500 km.
3. It uses a conventional warhead and has manoeuvrable re-entry capability.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Pralay is a quasi-ballistic short-range tactical surface-to-surface missile with a 150–500 km range, conventional warhead and manoeuvrable re-entry capability.
accepted.tq: Check each technical characteristic before selecting the coded combination.

accepted.s: A salvo of two Pralay missiles was fired on which date?
accepted.x: A salvo of two Pralay missiles was fired on 31 December 2025.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between closely spaced test dates.

accepted.s: Which one of the following missiles is a canister-launched, hypersonic, nuclear-capable surface-to-surface tactical missile with a range of about 700–1,900 km?
accepted.x: Shaurya is a canister-launched hypersonic surface-to-surface tactical missile with a range of about 700–1,900 km and nuclear capability.
accepted.tq: Use the range and launch-mode clues to identify the missile.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is correctly matched?
o: VL-SRSAM — Vertical-launch short-range SAM for Navy ships
QRSAM — Man-portable system against low-altitude threats
accepted.x: VL-SRSAM is a vertical-launch short-range surface-to-air missile intended for Navy ships and derived from Astra.
accepted.tq: Start with the platform and role that are most specific.

accepted.s: The weapon-control system of which missile was tested on a naval ship?
accepted.x: The weapon-control system of VL-SRSAM was tested on a naval ship. VL-SRSAM is derived from Astra.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the missile system from the related test activity.

accepted.s: QRSAM is associated with which of the following descriptions?
o: The mid-range layer of the Integrated Air Defence Weapon System
A man-portable system for very short-range air defence
accepted.x: QRSAM, or Quick Reaction Surface-to-Air Missile, forms the mid-range layer of the Integrated Air Defence Weapon System.
accepted.tq: Expand the abbreviation and connect it with its system role.

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
o: MPATGM — Third-generation fire-and-forget anti-tank guided missile
Prahaar — About 150 km tactical ballistic missile
VSHORADS — Man-portable air-defence system against low-altitude threats
accepted.x: LRGB Gaurav is a 1,000 kg glide bomb with a range of about 100 km, released from the Su-30MKI. The 120 km guided rocket is Pinaka LRGR-120.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped identity between two nearby weapon systems.

accepted.s:
With reference to MPATGM, consider the following statements:
1. It is man-portable.
2. It is a third-generation fire-and-forget anti-tank guided missile.
3. Its procurement was approved by the Defence Acquisition Council in July 2026.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: MPATGM is a man-portable, third-generation fire-and-forget anti-tank guided missile; its procurement was approved by the DAC in July 2026.
accepted.tq: Combine a weapon classification with its procurement milestone.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is correctly matched?
o: Rudram-II — Air-to-surface anti-radiation missile tested by the IAF
NASM-MR — Surface-to-air missile for naval ships
accepted.x: Rudram-II is an air-to-surface anti-radiation missile tested by the Indian Air Force. NASM-SR and NASM-MR are anti-ship missile developments, while LR-AShM is an anti-ship missile.
accepted.tq: Use the missile role as the decisive matching clue.

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about the new anti-ship missiles is correct?
1. NASM-SR is India's first indigenous helicopter-launched anti-ship missile.
2. NASM-SR uses an imaging infrared seeker.
3. NASM-MR had its maiden flight on 14 June 2026.
Select the correct answer using the code given below.
accepted.x: NASM-SR is the first indigenous helicopter-launched anti-ship missile and uses an imaging infrared seeker. NASM-MR had its maiden flight on 14 June 2026.
accepted.tq: Verify the weapon role, seeker type and dated milestone separately.

accepted.s: LRGB Gaurav is best described as a:
o: 120 km guided rocket launched from a naval ship
150 km tactical ballistic missile with a conventional warhead
350 km anti-radiation missile carried by the Tejas
1,000 kg glide bomb with a range of about 100 km, released from the Su-30MKI
accepted.x: LRGB Gaurav is a 1,000 kg glide bomb with an approximate range of 100 km and was released from the Su-30MKI in April 2025.
accepted.tq: Separate the glide bomb from missiles and guided rockets by its payload and launch platform.

accepted.s:
Arrange the following events in chronological order:
A. First flight of Pinaka LRGR-120
B. Salvo launch of two Pralay missiles
C. Release of LRGB Gaurav from Su-30MKI
D. Maiden flight of NASM-MR
accepted.x: LRGB Gaurav was released in April 2025, Pinaka LRGR-120 first flew on 29 December 2025, Pralay's salvo occurred on 31 December 2025, and NASM-MR's maiden flight was on 14 June 2026.
accepted.tq: Fix the dated events first and then arrange the sequence.

accepted.s: Which one of the following pairs is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: Spyder is an Israeli system used by the Indian Air Force and replaced Trishul. Iran is associated with Shahab and Fattah, not Spyder.
accepted.tq: Detect the substituted partner country in a bilateral defence list.
accepted.sec: Jointly developed and imported missiles - partner country  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements regarding Barak systems is correct?
o: Barak-8 was jointly developed with Russia and deployed only on submarines.
Barak-8 is a man-portable very short-range system.
Barak-1 is an Israeli Navy system that replaced Trishul.
Barak-1 is a Russian short-range air-to-air missile.
accepted.x: Barak-1 is an Israeli Navy system and replaced Trishul. Barak-8/MRSAM was developed by DRDO with Israel Aerospace Industries and is a medium-range surface-to-air system.
accepted.tq: Separate the similarly named Barak-1 and Barak-8 systems by partner and role.
accepted.sec: Jointly developed and imported missiles - partner country  [APPSC]

accepted.s: The R-73 Archer, listed among India's imported or jointly associated missile systems, is a:
accepted.x: The R-73 Archer is a Russian short-range air-to-air missile.
accepted.tq: Use the missile's class and country together for identification.
accepted.sec: Jointly developed and imported missiles - partner country  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following groups contains only missiles associated with Russia?
accepted.x: BrahMos is a joint venture with Russia, while R-73 Archer and S-400 are Russian systems. The other groups contain missiles associated with Israel, Iran, North Korea, Pakistan or the United States.
accepted.tq: Classify each item by partner or country before selecting the complete group.
accepted.sec: Jointly developed and imported missiles - partner country  [APPSC]

accepted.s: Which one of the following missile-country pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: Shahab is an Iranian ballistic missile series. Hwasong is associated with North Korea, Zircon with Russia and Abdali with Pakistan.
accepted.tq: Use country association to eliminate swapped foreign systems.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements:
1. Fattah is an Iranian missile claimed to be hypersonic in 2023.
2. Hwasong is a North Korean ICBM/IRBM series.
3. Zircon is a Russian ship-launched hypersonic cruise missile.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All three statements are correct: Fattah is associated with Iran, Hwasong with North Korea, and Zircon with Russia.
accepted.tq: Test country, missile category and launch mode together.

accepted.s: The Minuteman III is associated with which one of the following descriptions?
o: An American ICBM forming the land leg of the US nuclear triad
accepted.x: Minuteman III is a United States intercontinental ballistic missile and forms the land leg of the US nuclear triad.
accepted.tq: Identify the system from its strategic role rather than its name alone.

accepted.s: Which one of the following statements about Kinzhal is correct?
o: It is a Pakistani 450 km surface-to-surface missile.
It is an Iranian ballistic missile series.
It is a North Korean ship-launched cruise missile.
It is a Russian air-launched hypersonic missile.
accepted.x: Kinzhal is a Russian air-launched hypersonic missile. Six Kinzhal missiles were reportedly intercepted by Patriot systems in one night over Kyiv in May 2023.
accepted.tq: Distinguish Kinzhal from the ship-launched Zircon by launch platform.

accepted.s: Abdali, a 450 km surface-to-surface missile named after Ahmed Shah Abdali, belongs to which country?
accepted.x: Abdali is a Pakistani 450 km surface-to-surface missile named after Ahmed Shah Abdali.
accepted.tq: Combine the range and namesake clues with the country identification.

accepted.s: Astra is best classified as which one of the following?
o: A man-portable anti-tank guided missile with a laser seeker
A short-range surface-to-surface missile with an inertial seeker
A beyond-visual-range air-to-air missile family developed by DRDO with an active radar seeker
A ship-launched hypersonic cruise missile with an infrared seeker
accepted.x: Astra is a DRDO-developed family of beyond-visual-range air-to-air missiles using an active radar seeker.
accepted.tq: Identify the weapon by class, developer and seeker type.
accepted.sec: Astra - air-to-air class, variants, platforms  [other exams]

accepted.s: In the context of Astra missiles, BVR refers to the ability to engage targets beyond approximately:
accepted.x: Beyond Visual Range means engagement beyond 20 nautical miles, approximately 37 km.
accepted.tq: Convert the stated nautical-mile threshold into its paired kilometre value.
accepted.sec: Astra - air-to-air class, variants, platforms  [other exams]

accepted.s: Which one of the following combinations correctly describes Astra Mk-1?
o: About 700–1,900 km range and nuclear capability
80–110 km range, Mach 4.5 speed and altitude up to 20 km
About 200 km range and a dual-pulse solid motor
More than 350 km range and an SFDR engine
accepted.x: Astra Mk-1 has a range of 80–110 km, a speed of Mach 4.5 and an altitude capability up to 20 km.
accepted.tq: Match the variant with its distinctive range, speed and altitude figures.
accepted.sec: Astra - air-to-air class, variants, platforms  [other exams]

accepted.s:
With reference to Astra variants, consider the following statements:
1. Astra Mk-2 uses a dual-pulse solid motor.
2. Astra Mk-2 has a stated range of about 200 km in the latest specification.
3. Astra Mk-3, also called Gandiva, is under development with an SFDR engine and a range exceeding 350 km.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: Astra Mk-2 has a dual-pulse solid motor and an approximately 200 km range in the latest specification. Astra Mk-3 or Gandiva is under development with a solid fuel ducted ramjet engine and a range above 350 km.
accepted.tq: Separate present specifications from the older range figure and identify the development-stage variant.
accepted.sec: Astra - air-to-air class, variants, platforms  [other exams]

accepted.s: Astra Mk-1 is currently integrated with which aircraft and planned for which aircraft platforms?
o: Currently Rafale; planned for Su-30MKI and MiG-21
Currently Su-30MKI; planned for Tejas Mk-1A and Rafale
Currently P-17A frigates; planned for naval helicopters
Currently Tejas Mk-1A; planned for Pralay and Shaurya
accepted.x: Astra Mk-1 is deployed on the Su-30MKI and is planned for integration with the Tejas Mk-1A and Rafale.
accepted.tq: Distinguish the present platform from the planned platforms.
accepted.sec: Astra - air-to-air class, variants, platforms  [other exams]

accepted.s: ADA test-fired Astra from which platform on 12 March 2025?
accepted.x: The Aeronautical Development Agency test-fired Astra from an LCA AF Mk1 prototype on 12 March 2025.
accepted.tq: Use the exact test date to distinguish the aircraft platform involved.
accepted.sec: Astra - air-to-air class, variants, platforms  [other exams]

accepted.s: The agreement concluded in July 2026 between India and Indonesia regarding Astra represented which milestone?
o: The first import of Astra Mk-3 by India
The first joint development of Astra with Indonesia
The first-ever export of the Astra family
The replacement of Astra by a surface-to-air system
accepted.x: The India–Indonesia agreement of July 2026 marked the first-ever export of the Astra missile family.
accepted.tq: Identify the significance of a bilateral defence agreement.
accepted.sec: Astra - air-to-air class, variants, platforms  [other exams]
